candidates.decision_relevance: Would resolve repeated cross-horizon and ordering ambiguity among price, ETH/BTC, funding, open interest, breadth, microstructure, sentiment, and liquidation observations, including the unavailable 1-hour path and mismatched actual spans.
candidates.evidence_reference: Repeated daily reviews from 2026-08-25 through 2026-09-03; especially 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-03 outputs.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Only point-in-time snapshots and nominal horizons with shortened or zero actual spans are supplied, so persistence, sequence, and lead-lag relationships cannot be audited.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether apparent breadth improvement or deterioration persisted and whether it was broad participation rather than changing proxy membership.
candidates.evidence_reference: Repeated reviews cite changing top-100 membership hashes, endpoint-only breadth, and unavailable canonical breadth history.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Cross-capture breadth changes are not strictly comparable because universes and memberships changed; single endpoints cannot distinguish durable participation from transient or selection-driven moves.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would determine whether positive or negative ETF demand was persistent, concentrated, sequenced within the week, and associated with durable price response.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly report only one settled daily ETF observation, including 2026-08-24 through 2026-09-01 sessions.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF net flows
candidates.missing_history_problem: Single-session totals cannot establish flow persistence, concentration, offsetting outflows, or whether demand translated into sustained price support.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would provide the missing historical macro cross-check for the repeated risk-on/risk-off and liquidity interpretations.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews repeatedly state that macro fields are empty, disabled, or present only in predecessor context.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without aligned rates, dollar, and volatility observations, macro confirmation and the timing of macro-versus-crypto moves cannot be evaluated.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish genuine deleveraging and forced selling from incomplete or directionally ambiguous aggregate liquidation snapshots.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly identify liquidations as lower bounds from a fragile legacy REST window with unverified completeness.
candidates.metric_name: Complete liquidation and forced-flow event history
candidates.missing_history_problem: Aggregated lower bounds omit venue coverage, event timing, and liquidation direction, preventing reconstruction of stress sequences or comparison with price and open interest.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether stablecoin supply changes were accompanied by observable deployment or market-liquidity transmission rather than merely passive issuance.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews report stablecoin supply changes but repeatedly state that deployment, dominance, or transmission is unavailable.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Supply growth alone cannot show whether liquidity entered tradable risk assets or coincided with broader market participation.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit ex-ante audit and eventual calibration of the cited research candidates without relying on retrospective summaries.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W33-W35 and daily reviews repeatedly state that candidate definitions, issue times, evidence cutoffs, confidence, and matured outcomes are absent.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen forecast registry and matured outcome ledger
candidates.missing_history_problem: The record cannot verify what was known at issuance, distinguish broad-range containment from useful precision, or measure false positives, false negatives, calibration, and opportunity cost against the original specifications.
